name: Mono Oxygen Bangtao Beach
shortDescription: A small gated enclave of six villas in the Bang Tao beach area, sold by the Mono brand.
description: A small gated enclave of six villas in the Bang Tao beach area, sold by the Mono brand. Per portal listings the three-bedroom units each have a private pool, and only one remained on sale at the time of the portal check.
researchNotes: No official developer site found; developer not named (brand Mono). Keller Henson/Hipflat pages blocked or 404 when fetched, only search snippets: sinking fund 250 THB/sqm, freehold for Thai company proposed (unverified, not stored). Image is only a low-res portal thumbnail. Sold out almost entirely; the claimed price likely stale. Separate Phase 2 project exists nearby (23.5-24.0M per Lazudi). | Thailand-Property shows 1 unit from 22,989,000 THB (page also says 'Contact for price'). Search snippets show ~22.99M for 281.7 sqm 3BR. Does not match the claimed 21.5M. | claimed price 21500000
imageCredit: Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.
